title: LADA Doofers vs Sentinels, Oct 25
notes: Away game at Snoqualmie B: we wore light blue and had the right bench. YouTube had the video only at 1440p, and this upload sat 70 px low under a black band with a player's progress bar near the bottom; it was shifted back into place and scaled up for detection. It was also our first light-blue game at this rink: in its dim picture the usual light-blue test caught about one in six of our players on the ice, so Snoqualmie B now counts blue from a lower saturation, and the game was detected again with it.

The game sheet (SportNinja) gave the score, the scorers, the penalties, the shots and who played; each goal was found on the video and against the arena scoreboard, at 7:04, 29:15, 32:20 and 44:45 of the video. The board posted our first goal about two minutes late. The puck itself can't be seen in this upload, so the goal times come from the scrambles, the celebrations and the board. The video runs to the final horn.

Periods from the board's clock: the 1st from 0:11 to 18:04 of video, the 2nd from 19:41 to 38:05, the 3rd from 39:44 to 66:37. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd, with 3:00 minors on the board, and stopped at whistles in the 3rd, with 2:00 minors.

Fisenko #58, Turbo Kings' goalie, played goal as a sub. Ten skaters, two of them subs: Babkin #26 and Prozhogin #61. Absent: #0, #1, #4, #6, #11, #12, #13, #16, #20, #25, #27, #38, #44, #52, #54, #69, #90, #97. The game sheet marks Zaychikov #6 as playing, but no #6 appears on the video (every 6 read was part of 26, 46, 61 or 76, and no ZAYCHIKOV nameplate was read) and the ten fill the ice time.

Penalties: Polyanskiy #46's interference in the 2nd ran 3:00 on the board (2 minutes on the sheet); we played four from the whistle at 25:58 of video until Sentinels' power-play goal at 29:15. Albantov #29's interference in the 2nd, 3:00 (30:12 to 33:37), killed off, with Akulov's short-handed goal in it. Tislenok #98's unsportsmanlike conduct after a whistle in the 3rd, 2:00 (51:10 to 54:32), killed off. Sentinels' Maillot #12 sat 3:00 on the board for roughing in the 2nd.
Shots on goal from the game sheet: Doofers 31, Sentinels 37.

Labeled by hand: Tislenok #98's sleeve number reads as 91 on the video, so three review rows were set to #98, and one row to Sourov #31 where his nameplate showed. 28 on/off corrections came from a frame-by-frame check of every lineup gap, mostly line changes on the fly and players sitting at our bench whom the tracker counted as on the ice. The lineup at each goal matches the frame checks.
